title: A step toward: No circuit of fan-in-two AND/OR gates with at most 124 gates computes the incidence function of the projective plane of order 4 (step 1 of 2)
formal_statement: have x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∀ (x2 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x2) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x3 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), (↑x3 < (21 : ℕ) ∧ (21 : ℕ) ≤ ↑x4 ∧ (↑x4 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x3) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) ∧ x2 x3 = Bool.true ∧ x2 x4 = Bool.true; have x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∀ (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x2.gates[x3]? = Option.some x4 → x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ (x7 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), (x2.wires (List.ofFn x7)).getD ((42 : ℕ) + x3) Bool.false = Bool.true → x2.eval (List.ofFn x7) = Bool.true; have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → ℕ := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => List.countP (fun (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.casesOn x4.op Bool.false Bool.true Bool.false (fun (x5 : ℕ) => Bool.false) Bool.false) x3.gates; ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 → x1 x4 → ∃ (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x7 ∧ x1 x7 ∧ x2 x7 ∧ x3 x7 ≤ x3 x4
plain_statement: Step 1 of 2 of a checked cut of L-meta-4201.
